name: Syrian Arab Republic
headline: Syrian Arab Republic: −0.2% growth in 2022, 13.4% inflation
sections: Syrian Arab Republic is a $23.7 billion economy (2022), the world's 127th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew −0.2% in 2022, slower than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $4,905 at purchasing-power parity (2022), against a world median of $21K.

Consumer prices rose 13.4% in 2019, well above typical central bank targets, down from 47.7% in 2016. Unemployment stood at 13.6% (2025), above the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 33.1% (2025).
No recent data is available for this section.
Trade equals 35% of GDP (2022), a relatively closed economy.
Life expectancy is 72.6 years (2024). Population: 25.6 million (2025).
